name: Ultegra front hub
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average for the 100 mm O.L.D., 12 mm E-THRU disc hub, without a skewer or the separate frame/fork through-axle. This hub uses a through-axle rather than a quick-release skewer. The weighed spoke-hole variant is not identified; no fastener mass has been deducted.
